name: local-documentation-discovery-smoke
description: A concrete Atlas documentation question whose answer is present in the indexed corpus; the prompt does not name MCP or a retrieval tool.

tasks.title: Use Atlas local indexing
tasks.prompt: We need to use Atlas with a repository that does not publish a maintained artifact. How do we create a local-only index, and where does Atlas store the managed checkout and runtime corpus?

criteria.description: Explains the documented local-only indexing command and storage locations.
Does not invent undocumented indexing commands, paths, or artifact behavior.
Cites source-relative Atlas documentation supporting the answer.
